 News › Exams News › Date Sheet of Class 10 2027 CBSE Board: Check tentative exam dates and important questions to score … Date Sheet of Class 10 2027 CBSE Board: Check tentative exam dates and important questions to score well
 Jasleen Taneja Updated: Nov 5, 2026, 14:27 IST CBSE date sheet 2027 to be out soon The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) will release the CBSE date sheet 2027 for Classes 10 on the official website- cbse.gov.in soon. The CBSE exam dates are expected to be announced in the last week of November 2026.
 Students can check the tentative exam dates for Class 10 boards below. In this article, we have also shared the question bank released by the board to help students score well. Scroll below for more details.
 CBSE is expected to conduct the CBSE exams for Class 10th between February and March 2027. Students can check the tentative CBSE date sheet 2027 below and start with their revision.

 Class 10 cbse board exam date sheet 2027 will be released for main and second board.

 Steps to download CBSE Board Exam Date Sheet 2027 PDF 
 Here are the steps to download CBSE Date Sheet 2027.
 Visit board’s website at cbse.gov.in 
 On the home page, under latest updates, click on Class 10 CBSE 2027 Date Sheet link
 CBSE 2027 Date Sheet Class 10 opens on screen
 Download and save it
